title: Held Sounds
label: ch:ml-held-sounds
canDo: I can hear and say the difference a doubled consonant makes, and I know that Malayalam never uses stress to tell two words apart.

payoff.summary: From cold: the new verb, the held consonant that turns one word into another, how the doubling is written, and where the weight falls.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three. The verb is taught first because its stem supplies the contrast partner: kudi against kutti, which was taught in the child lesson, is the only gemination minimal pair available with one member already owned.
